title: Sanctum Pylon
pages: Craft this controller from four amethyst blocks, four sea lanterns and a Vitrified Amethyst, which the Blast Column fuses from four amethyst shards. It is a required t2 structure: one Attuned Starshard is the magical seal in the Leaching Vat craft, so the pylon must be formed before the aqueous tier opens.

Place a lodestone directly below the controller. At the same height as the controller, ring eight sea lanterns around it: one two blocks in each cardinal direction, and one two blocks diagonally at each corner. One block above the controller, place four amethyst blocks at the four cardinal positions. Two blocks above the controller, place a beacon as the capstone.

Right-click the formed pylon holding a full batch matching a loaded arcana_industry:sanctum_attunement recipe. It loads exactly one batch and attunes it for 40 ticks into one trait-imprinted carrier. Amethyst shards, quartz and glowstone dust produce Attuned Starshards for the Leaching Vat seal and other magic crafts. The other seventeen batches recover six useful carriers: prismarine shards from sea offerings, lapis from redstone/lapis/echo offerings, blaze powder from fire offerings, ender pearls from void offerings, leather from animal offerings and glow ink sacs from slime or glow ink. Each return is one item per batch, with its offering trait imprinted; consult JEI for exact input counts. Busy offerings are kept; empty-hand use collects the output.

Attunement keeps one property of the offering. The pylon reads the batch material traits, takes the strongest one (ties go to the lower trait ID), and imprints it on the returned carrier at strength trait x batch size / 2, capped at 5: two ender pearls give Umbral 3 on a returned pearl, while eight lapis give Pigment 5 on returned lapis. An imprinted item carries its trait into trait-aware machines. Differently imprinted carriers do not stack. The Attuned Starshard tooltip names its imprint; other carriers retain their imprint in item data. An offering with no traits is refused and kept.

Breaking the lodestone, any of the eight ring lanterns, any of the four pillar blocks or the capstone beacon stops attunement. Two pylons can share one ring lantern if placed four blocks apart on an axis; only the structurally complete controller may be used, and removing the shared lantern collapses both. JEI shows every loaded batch, and matching ties resolve by resource ID.

For automation, place a hopper in the open space directly above the controller, under the beacon, or run an item pipe into it; it fills the buffered stock slot with offerings that match a loaded batch. Every 40 ticks a formed pylon attunes one complete batch with the same trait imprint as a hand-fed offering; traitless stock waits instead of producing a blank carrier. The lodestone covers the bottom face, so sneak-use the south (or any open side) face once with an empty hand to set it to output and extract carriers there with a pipe. Empty-hand use collects buffered outputs; sneak-use cycles any face between input, output and disabled. Stock and outputs survive saves and chunk reloads, and a broken frame pauses work. The pylon has no FE or fluid port.
